That's not true! Monks study so as to learn God's mercy...
And what is God? God is nothing more than an idea. // The purer one's devotion to a single idea, the more one comes to cast out others... That is the natural end.
Ain't your logic goin' too far too? Besides, old man Kadmon aside, Tiara sure don't seem like that.
That woman never received a nun's formal training. // As for the man who bought his orders with gold, that needs no saying. Their will is not as pure as that monk's.
Can you really change how a person thinks that much? // To me, what you're sayin' is what don't make sense.
